title: Nearby Sacred Temples — 12 Jyotirlingas
description: For each of the 12 Jyotirlingas (plus Aundha Nagnath and Parli Vaijnath), nearby sacred temples that exist or are noted. Researched from official temple sites, tourism dept sites, and Wikipedia.

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhalka Tirth
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Lord Krishna temple; believed to be where Krishna left for his heavenly abode after being struck by a hunter's arrow

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Triveni Sangam
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred confluence of Hiran, Kapila, and Saraswati rivers meeting the Arabian Sea; pilgrims take a holy dip

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Parshuram Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: On the banks of Triveni river; where Lord Parshuram performed penance

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gita Temple (Birla)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Built by the Birlas; dedicated to Lord Krishna

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Dehotsarg Tirth
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Krishna's mortal body was cremated

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sakshi Ganapathi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ganesha 'registers' pilgrims' visits; a Srisailam pilgrimage is incomplete without visiting here first. Deity holds a book and pen

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Shikaresvara Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Panoramic views of the Nallamala hills

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhramaramba Devi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Shakti Peetha; consort of Mallikarjuna

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Pathala Ganga
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred spot on the Krishna River

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Hatakeswaram
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient Shiva shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Harsiddhi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas; walking distance. Features two huge deep-stambh (oil lamp towers)

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kal Bhairav Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Guardian deity of Ujjain; unique tradition of offering liquor to Bhairav

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bade Ganeshji Ka Mandir
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: One of the largest Ganesha idols in Madhya Pradesh

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Mangalnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Origin place of Mars (Mangal) planet per Matsya Purana

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Chintaman Ganesh Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient Ganesh temple; 'remover of worries'

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sandipani Ashram
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Lord Krishna, Sudama, and Balarama studied under Sage Sandipani

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gadkalika Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient Shakti shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Siddhavat Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred banyan tree site for ancestral rituals

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gopal Mandir
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Vaishnava temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Nagchandreshwar Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Opens only on Nag Panchami

nearby_sacred_temples.name: ISKCON Ujjain
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Krishna temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Ram Ghat
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: On Kshipra river; site of evening aarti

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Mamleshwar Temple (Amreshwar)
nearby_sacred_temples.distance: South bank of Narmada, across from island
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Considered the other half of the Omkareshwar Jyotirlinga. ASI-protected with inscriptions from 1063 AD

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Siddhanath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 13th-century architectural marvel; early medieval Brahminic architecture

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kedareshwar Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: At confluence of Narmada and Kaveri rivers; resembles Kedarnath temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gauri Somnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 11th-century Shiva-Parvati temple; Khajuraho-style architecture

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Govindeshwar Temple and Cave
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Adi Shankaracharya received initiation from Guru Govind Bhagwatpada

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Mahakaleshwar Temple (within complex)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: In Omkareshwar, Mahakal is above and Omkar is below (reversed in Ujjain)

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Panchmukhi Ganesh Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Self-manifested five-faced Ganesha idol

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhairavnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Guardian deity of Kedarnath; protects the temple during winter. Short uphill climb

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Tungnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Highest Shiva temple in India; one of the Panch Kedar

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Triyuginarayan Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Shiva and Parvati married; eternal flame burning for three yugas

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Guptkashi (Vishwanath & Ardhanarishwar Temples)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Popular stop; ancient Shiva shrines

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gaurikund
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where the road ends; temple of Goddess Parvati

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Rudraprayag
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Confluence of Alaknanda and Mandakini rivers

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Shankaracharya Samadhi
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Adi Shankaracharya took samadhi

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Vasuki Tal
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: High-altitude glacial lake

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kamalaja Mata Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Incarnation of Goddess Parvati who aided Shiva against demon Tripurasur

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gupt Bhimashankar
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Believed to be the original location of the self-manifested Shiva Linga; source of Bhima River

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Mokshakund Tirtha
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred kund; custom is to bathe here before darshan

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Shakini-Dakini Shrine
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Guardians who assisted Shiva in battle

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhorgiri Fort/Caves
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient fort with rock-cut caves; base for forest trek to Bhimashankar

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Shivneri Fort
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Lenyadri Caves (Ashtavinayak)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ashtavinayak temple in Buddhist-origin caves

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Ozar Vighneshwar Temple (Ashtavinayak)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ashtavinayak Ganesha temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kal Bhairav Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Guardian deity (Kotwal) of Kashi; tradition dictates visiting here first before any other temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Annapurna Devi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Goddess of food and nourishment; right next to Vishwanath

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Vishalakshi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: One of the 51 Shakti Peethas

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Mrityunjay Mahadev Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Believed to protect from untimely death; well with healing water

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sankata Devi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Goddess of Remedy; nine planetary shrines nearby

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Founded by Tulsidas; 'remover of troubles'

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Durga Temple (Durga Kund)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Iconic red 18th-century temple next to Durga Kund pond

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Tulsi Manas Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Tulsidas wrote Ramcharitmanas; verses inscribed on walls

nearby_sacred_temples.name: New Vishwanath Temple (BHU)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Modern marble temple, open to all; ~80 m high shikhara

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bharat Mata Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Inaugurated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1936; marble relief map of India

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Brahmagiri Hill
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred origin of the Godavari River; trek with steps to summit

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kushavarta Kund
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred pond where the Godavari is believed to emerge

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gangadwar
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Cave temple; first visible emergence point of the Godavari River

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Anjaneri Hill
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Believed to be the birthplace of Lord Hanuman

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Neel Parbat
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Hill for meditation and contemplation

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kalaram Temple (Nashik, ~28 km)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient temple dedicated to Lord Rama; intricately carved architecture

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sita Gufa (Nashik)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Cave where Sita stayed; believed to be where she was abducted by Ravana

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kapaleshwar Temple (Nashik)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Shiva shrine with ornate sculptures

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Ramkund (Nashik)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred tank where Rama and Sita performed ablutions

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Tapovan (Nashik)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Rama performed penance during exile

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Kothandaramaswamy Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where Vibhishana surrendered to Rama; only structure to survive 1964 cyclone. Idols of Rama, Sita, Lakshmana, Hanuman, Vibhishana

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gandamadana Parvatham
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Highest point on Rameswaram island; Lord Rama's footprints. Where Rama met Vibhishana

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Dhanushkodi / Sethu Theertham
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Southernmost tip; holy dip at Sethu considered very sacred. Site of mythical Ram Setu

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Agni Theertham
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred sea bath before entering temple

nearby_sacred_temples.name: 22 Theerthams (wells within temple)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 22 sacred wells; pilgrims bathe at all 22 as part of pilgrimage

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Satchi Hanuman Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Hanuman shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Nambu Nayagiar Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Local shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Dwarkadhish Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Famous Krishna temple in Dwarka; one of the Char Dham

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Beyt Dwarka
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Island; believed to be Krishna's original residence

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gomti Ghat
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Where the Gomti River meets the ocean; devotees take a holy dip

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Rukmini Devi Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Dedicated to Krishna's consort; 12th-century paintings

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Gopi Talav Tirth
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Famous for yellow-colored sand called Gopi Chandan

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bhadkeshwar Mahadev Mandir
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Shiva temple on the coast

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Basukinath Dham
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Important Shiva shrine; worship here purifies the soul and fulfills wishes. Visited as a pair with Baidyanath

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Trikut Parvat (Trikutachal Mahadeva Temple)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Three-peaked hill with Shiva temple in dense forest; ropeway available. Sage Dayananda's hermitage, Ravana's Cave

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Satsang Ashram
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Founded by Thakur Anukul Chandra; spiritual retreat

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Rikhiapeeth
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ashram of Swami Satyananda Saraswati

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Shivganga
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sacred pond where devotees take a holy dip

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Naulakha Mandir
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Beautiful temple with intricate architecture

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Taponath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient cave shrine

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Ellora Caves (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 34 rock-cut caves (5th-10th century CE); Buddhist, Hindu, Jain. Kailasa Temple (Cave 16) carved from single rock

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Daulatabad Fort (Devagiri Fort)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Medieval fort with unique defense mechanisms and secret escape routes

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Bibi Ka Maqbara
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 'Taj of the Deccan'; built by Aurangzeb's son Azam Shah

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Aurangabad Caves
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: 6th-7th century Buddhist rock-cut shrines

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Ajanta Caves (UNESCO World Heritage Site)
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Ancient Buddhist paintings and sculptures

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Parli Vaijnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Another Jyotirlinga; combined pilgrimage circuit

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Hazur Sahib, Nanded
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: One of the five Takhts of Sikhism; final resting place of Guru Gobind Singh Ji

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Siddheshwar Dam
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Picturesque spot for relaxation

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Sant Namdev Sansthan
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Honoring saint-poet Namdev

nearby_sacred_temples.name: 12 mini Jyotirlinga shrines + 108 smaller temples
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Replicas of all 12 Jyotirlingas within the complex

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Aundha Nagnath Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Jyotirlinga circuit partner

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Yogeshwari Devi Temple, Ambajogai
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Goddess Yogeshwari shrine with ancient caves nearby

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Hazur Sahib, Nanded
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Sikh Takht; final resting place of Guru Gobind Singh Ji

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Tulja Bhavani Temple
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Shakti Peetha; kuldevi of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj

nearby_sacred_temples.name: Dharur Fort
nearby_sacred_temples.significance: Historical fort

research_sources: District administration websites (girsomnath.nic.in, ujjain.nic.in, varanasi.nic.in, devbhumidwarka.nic.in)
